items.description: Root directory path or path variable. Relative directories are resolved against each workspace folder.

fastQuickOpen.roots.markdownDescription: fd **base** directories for the default index (one fd process per resolved root; relative entries resolve against each workspace folder). A root nested inside another configured root still gets its own fd base, excluded from the parent so files aren't duplicated. See [path variables](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#path-variables) for supported `${...}` values, and `#fastQuickOpen.exclude#` / `#fastQuickOpen.include#` for filtering.

fastQuickOpen.include.markdownDescription: Directories to restore when excluded by `#fastQuickOpen.exclude#` (or files/search excludes). Map of path → `true`/`false`; relative paths resolve against each `#fastQuickOpen.roots#` entry. See [include and exclude](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#include-and-exclude).

additionalProperties.description: Whether the include path is enabled.

fastQuickOpen.exclude.markdownDescription: Additional [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) excluded from indexing and file-watcher reloads, on top of enabled `#files.exclude#` / `#search.exclude#` patterns when `#fastQuickOpen.useSearchExclude#` is enabled. Map of pattern → `true`/`false`. Conditional `files.exclude` entries using `when` are ignored. Applies to the default index only — `#fastQuickOpen.onDemand#` scopes are not excluded automatically. See [include and exclude](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#include-and-exclude) for anchoring rules.

additionalProperties.description: Whether the glob pattern is enabled.

fastQuickOpen.useSearchExclude.markdownDescription: Also apply boolean entries from both `#files.exclude#` and `#search.exclude#` when indexing and watching. Conditional `files.exclude` entries using `when` are ignored. See also `#fastQuickOpen.exclude#`.

fastQuickOpen.useWatcherExclude.markdownDescription: Also apply `#files.watcherExclude#` patterns when deciding whether a file create/delete event should trigger a reindex.

fastQuickOpen.reloadDebounceSeconds.markdownDescription: Quiet period in seconds before file-watcher notifications rebuild the index when the Quick Pick is closed. Set to `0` to keep watcher reloads pending until the Quick Pick is opened.

fastQuickOpen.fdHidden.markdownDescription: Pass fd `--hidden` to include hidden files and directories. See also `#fastQuickOpen.fdNoIgnore#` and `#fastQuickOpen.fdFlags#`.

fastQuickOpen.fdNoIgnore.markdownDescription: Pass fd `--no-ignore` to skip `.gitignore` and other ignore files. See also `#fastQuickOpen.fdHidden#` and `#fastQuickOpen.fdFlags#`.

fastQuickOpen.fdPattern.markdownDescription: fd search [pattern](https://github.com/sharkdp/fd#pattern) (positional regex by default; add `--glob` via `#fastQuickOpen.fdFlags#` for glob syntax).

fastQuickOpen.fdFlags.markdownDescription: Extra fd flags appended to the indexer command, e.g. `["--max-depth", 4]`. Expands [path variables](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#path-variables). See also `#fastQuickOpen.fdPattern#` and `#fastQuickOpen.fzfFlags#`.

fastQuickOpen.fzfFlags.markdownDescription: Extra fzf flags appended after `--scheme=path`, e.g. `["--tiebreak=end"]`. Expands [path variables](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#path-variables). See also `#fastQuickOpen.fdFlags#`.

fastQuickOpen.maxItems.markdownDescription: Maximum number of files shown in the picker. `#fastQuickOpen.onDemand#` scopes may override this individually.

items.description: A prefill template. May mix literal text with variables.

fastQuickOpen.prefill.markdownDescription: Templates to prefill `Fast Quick Open`'s (`extension.fastQuickOpen`) input with; the first that expands to a non-empty string is used. A keybinding can override this per-invocation with `"args": { "prefill": [...] }` (refills instead of cycling the selection, unless the same `args` were used to open/refill the currently shown picker). See [prefill variables](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#prefill-variables) for the supported `${...}` values.

fastQuickOpen.lowercaseQuery.markdownDescription: Lowercase the query before matching (case-insensitive), runs before `#fastQuickOpen.queryReplace#`. Disable to use fzf [smart-case](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf#search-syntax): all-lowercase stays case-insensitive; any uppercase letter makes the query case-sensitive.

fastQuickOpen.queryReplace.markdownDescription: Regex rewrite rules applied to the query before matching, after `#fastQuickOpen.lowercaseQuery#` (so keep `find` lowercase while that's on). Rules run in top-level declaration order. Plain rules apply wherever they appear; the first matching group runs in full, later groups are skipped, and later plain rules still run. The rewritten query is what `#fastQuickOpen.onDemand#` and fzf see. Invalid rules are skipped and reported once. See [query rewrite rules](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#query-rewrite-rules) for the accepted shapes and examples.

find.markdownDescription: JavaScript regular expression source to search for.

flags.markdownDescription: Regular expression flags. Omit to replace only the first match; use `g` to replace all.

oneOf.markdownDescription: A rule group. The first group whose first rule matches the query runs in full; later groups are skipped, but later plain rules still run.

find.markdownDescription: JavaScript regular expression source to search for. On the first rule of a group this is also the group's condition.

flags.markdownDescription: Regular expression flags. Omit to replace only the first match; use `g` to replace all.

fastQuickOpen.onDemand.markdownDescription: Per-key on-demand fd/fzf scopes, built the first time a query starts with the key. Not inherited from top-level `fastQuickOpen.*` settings. See [on-demand scopes](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#on-demand-scopes).

items.description: Root directory path or path variable.

roots.markdownDescription: fd base directories for this scope; defaults to `["<key>"]` when omitted. Same [path variables](https://github.com/goodov/fast-quick-open#path-variables) as `#fastQuickOpen.roots#`, including `${workspaceFolderList}`.

include.markdownDescription: Directories to restore when excluded within this scope. Not inherited from `#fastQuickOpen.include#`.

exclude.markdownDescription: [Glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) excluded for this scope. Not inherited from `#fastQuickOpen.exclude#`.

keepKeyInQuery.description: Pass the full query (including the scope key) to fzf instead of stripping the key.

lifecycle.description: Whether this scope's fzf instance stays running after the picker closes.

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
